websiteContent.heroSubtitle: Handmade flowers, crafted with love and made to last.
websiteContent.aboutStory: Flora7 was born out of a passion for eternal florals and handmade artistry. Each satin ribbon rose is individually shaped, folded, and assembled by hand to create everlasting gifts that never fade.
websiteContent.craftedByShwethaText: Every piece is personally hand-crafted by Shwetha with utmost attention to ribbon texture, color harmony, and delicate embellishments.
websiteContent.privacyPolicy: At Flora7, we respect your privacy. Customer contact details and addresses are strictly used for fulfilling flower orders and delivery notifications.
websiteContent.termsConditions: All Flora7 creations are 100% handmade upon order. Minor handcrafted variations add to their unique bespoke beauty.
websiteContent.deliveryPolicy: Local Bangalore orders are delivered within 1-2 days via courier or direct studio pickup in Koramangala.
websiteContent.cancellationPolicy: Orders can be cancelled or modified within 4 hours of placement before hand-crafting commences.
websiteContent.returnPolicy: Due to the custom handmade nature of our products, returns are accepted in case of shipping damage or defective items.
